newsitem.title: UK: Shield surges ahead of annual results.
newsitem.headline: Shield surges ahead of annual results.

text.p: Shares in Shield Diagnostics Plc surged 7.6 percent in early trading on Monday ahead of the company's annual results, due on Tuesday.
By 0754 GMT, the shares were up 40p to 565, resuming a two-week rally.
The group is expected to report a loss of one million stg for the fiscal year ended in March, according to the average estimate of three analysts.
One market maker cited hopes for good news on the group's AFT cardiovascular disease diagnostics test, which was submitted for approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration only a week ago.
"This stock moves on a whim," said one market maker.
No one at the company was immediately available to comment. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
